questions.q: In which comic did the Red Skull make his first appearance in 1941?
questions.why: He turns up already fighting the hero in Captain America Comics #1, dated March 1941.

questions.q: What is the Red Skull's real name in the comics?
questions.why: Johann Shmidt was a Nazi who became the Red Skull, Hitler's personal head of terror.

questions.q: Who played the Red Skull in the 1990 direct-to-video superhero film?
questions.why: Scott Paulin took the role in the 1990 direct-to-video movie.

questions.q: Which actor plays the Red Skull as the stonekeeper in Avengers: Infinity War?
questions.why: Ross Marquand took over as the Red Skull, who guards the Soul Stone, in Infinity War and Endgame.

questions.q: On which planet does the MCU Red Skull guide seekers of the Soul Stone?
questions.why: Schmidt was transported to Vormir after the first Cap film and became its stonekeeper.

questions.q: Which real historical figure did the Red Skull serve in the comics?
questions.why: Hitler gave the red skull mask to his protege and made him the Reich's head of terror and espionage.

questions.q: Who wrote and drew the Red Skull's 1941 debut story?
questions.why: Joe Simon and Jack Kirby wrote and drew Captain America Comics #1, where the Skull first appears.

questions.q: Which Nazi geneticist transferred the Red Skull's mind into a clone body?
questions.why: Arnim Zola obtained Steve Rogers' DNA and used it to clone a new body for the Skull's mind.

questions.q: From which organization did the Red Skull steal the Cosmic Cube in the comics?
questions.why: He stole the Cosmic Cube from Advanced Idea Mechanics before building his own reality-warping device.

questions.q: Which villain is the Red Skull's daughter, who briefly took his name after being scarred?
questions.why: Sinthea Shmidt, called Sin, is Johann's daughter and briefly used the Red Skull name after being scarred.
